title: Interests & Passions
metaDescription: Pasquale Carmine Carbone's interests and passions: programming, technological innovation, continuous learning and problem solving.

header.title: Interests & Passions
header.description: What motivates me, inspires me and guides my professional and personal growth

upstream.title: Upstream Open Source Contributions
upstream.description: More than 40 merged pull requests to the projects I use every day. When I hit a limit, I fix it at the source instead of building a workaround.
details: Merged contributions to Mastra, SvelteKit, Node.js undici and Home Assistant
Merged contributions across the Fastify ecosystem
Documented issues and reproductions before proposing a fix
Fixes contributed back rather than kept as local patches

mastra.name: mastra-ai/mastra
mastra.description: AI agent framework. Contributions to the core: AWS credential provider chain for S3, abort signal propagation from parent to delegated sub-agents, provider metadata surfaced to output processors.
mastra.impact: Fixes and features merged upstream while building production agents, so the team avoided maintaining local patches

vercelAi.name: vercel/ai
vercelAi.description: Investigated and documented a bug in the Amazon Bedrock provider: <reasoning> tags leaking into the text response during multi-turn tool use, with a proposed fix for unsigned reasoning content in multi-turn messages.
vercelAi.impact: Root cause isolated and reported upstream with a reproduction, so other teams hitting the same leak had a documented explanation

sveltekit.name: sveltejs/kit
sveltekit.description: Validation of the ORIGIN environment variable at startup in adapter-node, from an issue I reported about misleading 400 Bad Request responses.
sveltekit.impact: Turns a confusing runtime failure into a clear error at boot for every adapter-node user

homeAssistant.name: home-assistant/core + blinkpy
homeAssistant.description: Reimplemented the Blink authentication flow upstream when the vendor changed it: new OAuth flow, OTP handling via the mobile app, proper error on invalid credentials. Then propagated the fix into Home Assistant core.
homeAssistant.impact: Restored working camera integration for Home Assistant users after the vendor broke the previous login flow

undici.name: nodejs/undici
undici.description: Handling of the maxCachedSessions option in the connect class, plus additional test coverage for errors and the client.
undici.impact: Merged into the HTTP client used by Node.js itself

fastify.name: Fastify ecosystem
fastify.description: Type definitions for clientErrorHandler and Fastify-typed req/res in the serializer log, support for additionalItems in arrays and enum handling in fast-json-stringify, option to hide untagged routes in fastify-swagger.
fastify.impact: Contributions merged across fastify, fastify-plugin, fastify-swagger and fast-json-stringify

openSource.title: Open Source & Community
openSource.description: Actively contributing to the tech community through open source projects and knowledge sharing.
details: Development and maintenance of open source libraries, over 200 stars on GitHub
Documented issues and technical discussions on GitHub
Mentoring junior developers
Contributions to existing community projects

fastapiController.name: fastapi-router-controller
fastapiController.description: FastAPI utility library that simplifies controller and routing management.
fastapiController.impact: Simplifies FastAPI REST API development by reducing boilerplate code by 40%

vitePluginSveltekitDecorators.name: vite-plugin-sveltekit-decorators
vitePluginSveltekitDecorators.description: Vite plugin that automatically decorates SvelteKit functions with decorators, enhancing code organization and readability.
vitePluginSveltekitDecorators.impact: Improves code organization in SvelteKit projects by automatically applying decorators to functions, reducing boilerplate and enhancing readability

fastapiMvcBoilerplate.name: fastapi-mvc-boilerplate
fastapiMvcBoilerplate.description: Reference FastAPI project implementing the MVC pattern, used as a starting point for new services.
fastapiMvcBoilerplate.impact: 27 stars and 5 forks: a ready-made structure for teams starting a FastAPI project

vscodeMastraTraceViewer.name: vscode-mastra-trace-viewer
vscodeMastraTraceViewer.description: Visual Studio Code extension to explore and analyse trace data from Mastra AI agents and workflows.
vscodeMastraTraceViewer.impact: Makes agent traces readable inside the editor, without switching to an external tool

smartHome.title: Smart Home & Home Automation
smartHome.description: Design and implement home automation solutions to simplify daily life.
details: Complete system with HomeAssistant as central hub
Custom automations for energy saving
Integration of IoT devices from different manufacturers
Development of custom integrations when needed

switchbotRemote.name: ha-switchbot-remote
switchbotRemote.description: Custom HomeAssistant integration supporting unofficially supported SwitchBot Remote devices.
switchbotRemote.impact: Enables control of SwitchBot Remote devices via HomeAssistant, filling a gap in the ecosystem

lgTvControl.name: LG TV Control Server
lgTvControl.description: Node.js server to control LG TVs via Google Home, enabling non-native features.
lgTvControl.impact: Enables complete voice control of LG TVs via Google Home with custom commands

innovation.title: Technological Innovation
innovation.description: Constantly exploring emerging technologies and their application potential.
details: Experimentation with AI and Machine Learning
Rapid prototyping of new ideas
Participation in hackathons and contests
Study of emerging technologies (Web3, IoT, Edge Computing)

gullivr.name: Gullivr — app on ChatGPT
gullivr.description: Collaborative trip planner, published as an app on the OpenAI platform. Plan day-by-day itineraries, flights, places to stay, shared expenses and packing lists, either from the web app or by asking ChatGPT directly. Exposes 46 MCP tools, each with declared safety annotations.
gullivr.impact: Passed OpenAI review and is available inside ChatGPT: an entire product controllable in natural language, without leaving the conversation

aiFaq.name: AI FAQ Chatbot (MongoDB Hackathon Winner)
aiFaq.description: Intelligent chatbot for corporate FAQs using MongoDB Atlas Vector Search and FireworksAI.
aiFaq.impact: 1st place at MongoDB Hackathon 2024 - Reduces customer support load by 60%

smartTeacher.name: Smart Teacher (KPN Hackathon)
smartTeacher.description: Voice assistant for learning using Google Assistant and Google Home.
smartTeacher.impact: 3rd place at KPN ITV Hackathon 2019 - Improves students' study experience
